$comment: Upstream's integration suites on celld (celld plan item 0.5); celld/integration.sh runs them.

passing: suites that pass on celld. It only grows: the runner fails when one stops passing (REGRESSION, or FLAKY if a second run passes), and --update adds a pending or unlisted suite that passes, never an excluded one.

pending: runnable suites that do not pass yet, each as "<text of its first error> -> <the trial failure or plan item it maps to>"; the runner warns when a suite's first error no longer contains that text. All of them pass on the workerd reference (--workerd).
excluded: suites the runner does not run by default, with the reason.
